problem_text:
A logistics firm must coordinate a specialized drone to inspect four remote monitoring stations positioned at the following coordinates on a grid:

Station Alpha: (0, 156)
Station Beta: (126, 85)
Station Gamma: (62, 186)
Station Delta: (83, 180)

The flight distances between stations, measured in kilometers, are precisely known:
Alpha to Gamma: 68.9 km
Alpha to Delta: 86.4 km
Beta to Gamma: 119.6 km
Beta to Delta: 104.3 km
Gamma to Delta: 21.8 km

Due to restricted airspace, a direct flight corridor between Station Alpha and Station Beta is unavailable.
Furthermore, a specific operational protocol mandates that the inspection tour must incorporate exactly one of the following two critical flight segments: either the route between Station Beta and Station Gamma, or the route between Station Gamma and Station Delta.

The objective is to determine the most efficient closed-loop flight path that visits each monitoring station exactly once and returns to the origin, minimizing the total distance traversed.
